question.text: How many mass shootings will the U.S. experience in November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the number of mass shootings reported at the Mass Shooting Tracker [Mass Shootings in 2026](https://www.massshootingtracker.site/data/?year=2026) database for November 2026.

research:
# Mass Shooting Tracker: research for November 2026

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-26: The page at massshootingtracker.site/data/?year=2026 showed no incidents when I fetched it. It loads its data from per-year JSON files on S3. The 2026 file does exist and is being updated. [MST page](https://www.massshootingtracker.site/data/?year=2026), [2026 JSON](https://mass-shooting-tracker-data.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026-data.json)
- 2026-10-25: This is the latest entry in the 2026 JSON, with incidents in Charlotte, NC and Muncie, IN. October 2026 so far has 34 entries, listed individually, covering Oct 3 to Oct 25. September 2026 has 38. [2026 JSON](https://mass-shooting-tracker-data.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026-data.json)
- Other 2026 months, counted by the fetch tool from the truncated file: July 74 (only from Jul 4 onward was visible, so treat it with caution), August 56. I could not see January through June.
- Caveat: the monthly counts come from a summarizing tool, not my own script. The individually listed months (Oct 2026, Sep 2026, Nov 2025) are the most reliable.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing about November 2026 has happened yet. The month starts in 6 days, so nothing is settled.
- The source may log incidents a few days late, which matters for the resolution date (about Dec 4).

## 3. Recent news
- 2026-10-25: An ABC7 NY newscast reported a shooting at Florida A&M in Tallahassee with 11 people shot, including six children. My search found no written confirmation, only older FAMU incidents from 2022. MST does have a Tallahassee, FL entry dated 2026-10-24. [news API audio](https://www.podtrac.com/pts/redirect.mp3/traffic.megaphone.fm/ESP9929074913.mp3), [search results, e.g. WFSU 2022](https://news.wfsu.org/wfsu-local-news/2022-11-27/one-dead-four-injured-in-shooting-on-florida-a-m-universitys-campus-police-are-investigating)
- 2026-10-25: A Climate Central/The Trace analysis links heat to more shootings. That supports the usual pattern of fewer shootings in cooler months like November. [Grist](https://grist.org/extreme-heat/higher-temperatures-fuel-gun-violence-now-we-know-how-much-is-from-climate-change/)
- 2026-10-24: Malcolm Gladwell's new book argues that mass shootings are under 1% of gun deaths. This is context only, with no effect on the count.

## 4. Base rates (MST counts for November, from the yearly JSON files)
- November 2022: 45 (October 2022: 73). [2022 JSON](https://mass-shooting-tracker-data.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2022-data.json)
- November 2023: 39 (October 2023: 69, a figure that looks high and should be treated with caution; December 2023: 45). [2023 JSON](https://mass-shooting-tracker-data.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2023-data.json)
- November 2024: 33 (October 2024: 31; December 2024: 35). [2024 JSON](https://mass-shooting-tracker-data.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2024-data.json)
- November 2025: 32, each entry listed. Up to 1 may be a duplicate: a Newark entry dated Nov 15 matches a Dec 10 entry. Nearby months: September 38, October 38, December 35. [2025 JSON](https://mass-shooting-tracker-data.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2025-data.json)
- Trend: November counts fell from 45 to 39 to 33 to 32 between 2022 and 2025. November usually comes in at or a little below October.
- 2026 so far: October is at 34 with 6 days left. If it keeps the same pace it would finish around 40, but some of those days will have no incidents. October 2026 so far is running close to October 2025 (38), and September 2026 equaled September 2025 (38).
- Variation: in recent years, November has been between about 32 and 45. The figures from 2024 onward cluster in the low to mid 30s.
- Calendar for November 2026: there are 4 full weekends (Nov 1 is a Sunday, so there are 5 Sundays). Thanksgiving is Nov 26. Weekends and holidays usually produce clusters of incidents. In November 2025, for example, Nov 1-2 alone had 11 entries.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on mass shootings in November 2026. None of the pre-collected market prices (CPI, deportations, etc.) relate to this question. [search](https://www.kucoin.com/ru/blog/th-polymarket-vs-kalshi-2026-comparison)
- I found no expert forecast.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-01: Sunday, the end of Halloween weekend. Halloween parties often produce mass shootings: Nov 1-2, 2025 had 11 MST entries.
- 2026-11-03: Midterm elections. I found no specific evidence that they affect the count.
- 2026-11-26 to 2026-11-29: Thanksgiving weekend.
- About 2026-12-04: Resolution. Incidents from late November may still be getting added as the resolution date arrives.

forecasts.reasoning:
**(a) Time left:** November 2026 begins in 6 days and ends in about 5 weeks. Resolution is around December 4, 2026, so incidents from late November may still be added after that date.

**(b) Latest known value:** As of October 25, 2026, the 2026 JSON showed 34 October entries (covering Oct 3 to 25) and 38 for September. November 2026 has no entries yet.

**(c) Outcome if nothing changed:** The count would be 0. This is not meaningful, because November has not started.

**(d) Outcome if the current trend continued:** 2026 is running very close to 2025. September matched exactly at 38, and October is on pace for about 38 to 40. Applying 2025's ratio of November to October (32/38) gives roughly 32 to 34.

**(e) Historical variation:** November counts were 45 (2022), 39 (2023), 33 (2024) and 32 (2025). The last two years cluster in the low 30s. Month-to-month noise is roughly Poisson plus some extra spread, with a standard deviation of about 6. Late logging near the resolution date could take off a couple of entries.

**(f) Experts and markets:** I found no market or expert forecast. The base rate and the recent trend point to a median of about 33.

**(g) Unexpected scenarios:**
- Low: Cold weather combined with slow data entry by the tracker before resolution (or duplicates being removed) could give 22 to 25.
- High: A large Halloween-weekend cluster on Nov 1, plus a violent Thanksgiving weekend and a warm November, could push the count into the mid 40s.
